overall_goal: Prepare a spice and lemon marinade and toss the mushrooms in it to coat

goals.description: Set up the mixing bowl and gather the first set of spices
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the large mixing bowl and places the first few spice containers on the countertop.

goals.description: Search through the basket to gather the remaining spice packets
goals.rationale: The person searches through a basket of spice packets to find the remaining spices needed for the recipe.

goals.description: Check the recipe, retrieve a teaspoon, and add coriander to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person checks the recipe, gets a teaspoon from the drawer, and measures coriander into the mixing bowl.

goals.description: Measure and add cumin, paprika, and nutmeg to the spice mixture
goals.rationale: The person measures out cumin, paprika, and nutmeg, adding each to the mixing bowl.

goals.description: Measure and add ginger, cayenne pepper, and salt to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person measures out ginger, cayenne pepper, and salt, adding them to the spice mixture.

goals.description: Retrieve a tablespoon, measure the olive oil, and mix it with the spices
goals.rationale: The person swaps the teaspoon for a tablespoon, measures the olive oil, and mixes it with the spices.

goals.description: Fetch a lemon, cut it in half, and squeeze its juice into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a lemon from the fridge, cuts it in half with a chef's knife, and squeezes the juice into the bowl.

goals.description: Stir the lemon juice into the marinade and toss the mushrooms to coat them evenly
goals.rationale: The person stirs the lemon juice into the marinade and tosses the mushrooms to ensure they are evenly coated.
